summary: The /marine-finance/ page is titled 'Boat Finance UK' in search results. According to the search tool summaries of results (a) and (b), it describes tailored financing for superyacht purchases, lists the firm's services as borrow, develop, refinance and acquire, and offers boat finance for yachts typically over 20m in length. Financed yachts are usually registered in the UK, Cayman Islands, BVI or Malta; commercial vessels are mentioned but must be enquired about directly. Two product types are named: Pre-build Payment Financing and Senior Secured Mortgage (Post-build). Sample terms cited: up to 70% LTV based on an independent valuation, 48-month term, interest-only payments. A typical broker fee of 1.00% of the loan amount is cited (attribution to this page vs the /types-of-borrowing/ page is inconsistent between results). Stated advantages: '300+ Lenders' and 'independent whole-of-market advice'. Contact details on the page: London W1 and enquiry@silveroakcapital.co.uk. No meta description, H1, FAQ, process steps, testimonials or awards were revealed for this page. Search (c) returned only unrelated marine-industry results.
